hub.title: After Effects AI Hub
hub.tagline: Guides, prompts, update notes and a vetted template directory for using AI agents in Adobe After Effects. Images are stored in the repo; the site rebuilds itself on every push.

entries.summary: Condensed write-up of the full transcript: AI Assistant and its credit cost, 3D materials on text and shapes, Illustrator text, Contour Paint, Quick Apply history and more, with timestamp links.
